cohort: 1102 pregnant women (48% Indigenous) from the Pregnancy And Neonatal Diabetes Outcomes in Remote Australia (PANDORA) Study
finding: Indigenous women with hyperglycemia in pregnancy (GDM or T2DM) were at a significantly higher risk of PPH compared to non-Indigenous women with normoglycemia, suggesting a greater impact of hyperglycemia on PPH risk in Indigenous populations.
birth_weight: Controlled for in the adjusted analyses
